comparison.objective: Open a stepladder fully until its spreader locks.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace one section while drawing the other apart and engaging a passive lock.
comparison.success_condition: Sections fully open, spreader locked, four feet supported; falling over permanently fails. Body supplies thresholds but no separate spec.
comparison.reason: Its central mechanism is large-scale articulated opening and latching, unlike coaxial micro-tool alignment, hammering, and fragment collection.
